warning.title: Trade safely
warning.text: Coffer does not handle payments. Advance payment and shipping are at your own risk — only pay in advance or ship to people you trust. Prefer personal pickup and pay on the spot.

privateSellerNote: Private seller — consumer rights that apply to shops and businesses (e.g. 14-day return) don't apply.

venue.title: Coffer is only the venue
venue.text: Coffer helps you find each other, chat and confirm the handover. Coffer is not a party to any deal, does not handle payments and gives no guarantee about items, payments or deliveries.

responsibility.title: Deals are your own responsibility
responsibility.text: Price, payment and shipping are agreed between buyer and seller. Advance payment and shipping are at your own risk — only do it with people you trust. Prefer personal pickup and paying on the spot.

disputes.title: Coffer does not settle disputes
disputes.text: If something goes wrong, sort it out with the other person. A buyer can mark a shipped deal as disputed; the deal then closes and both of you can leave an honest review. Coffer never decides who is right.

adults.title: Private persons, 18+
adults.text: The marketplace is for private persons aged 18 or over selling their own collectibles. Businesses may not sell here.

contentRules.title: Content rules
contentRules.text: No illegal or banned items, counterfeits sold as originals, scams, harassment, other people's personal data, spam, or fake reviews. Anyone can report content; Coffer removes what breaks these rules and tells the author why.

reviews.title: Verified reviews
reviews.text: Only the buyer and seller of a deal completed with a PIN handover or a tracked shipment (or closed as disputed) can review each other. Reviews stay hidden until both have reviewed or 14 days pass.

terms.title: Before you start trading
terms.privatePerson: I trade as a private person, not as a business.

illegal_item.label: Illegal or banned item

counterfeit.label: Counterfeit or replica
counterfeit.description: A copy or replica offered or shown as an original.

scam_or_fraud.label: Scam or fraud attempt
scam_or_fraud.description: Phishing, fake payment requests, asking for passwords or bank details.

harassment.label: Harassment, threats or hate
harassment.description: Insults, threats, hate speech or sexual content.

personal_data.label: Someone's personal data
personal_data.description: Publishing addresses, phone numbers or documents of another person.

spam.label: Spam or advertising
spam.description: Repeated posts, ads for other services or links unrelated to the item.

fake_review.label: Fake or unrelated review
fake_review.description: A review that is about something other than this deal, or clearly invented.

off_topic.label: Off-topic
off_topic.description: Content that is not about a collectible item or the deal.

ship.title: Register shipment
ship.errorChars: Only letters, digits, spaces and dashes.
ship.explanation: The buyer will see the carrier and tracking number and can check it on the carrier's website. If the buyer doesn't confirm or report a problem within 14 days, the deal completes automatically.

receipt.title: Confirm receipt
receipt.explanation: Confirm only when the parcel is in your hands. This completes the deal; if something is wrong, use “Report a problem” instead.
